about: Gate 203 (node, no browser) runs the shipped concreteRead over 150 library puzzle positions and the job's fixtures, every legal move of each, against a mate-in-one fact computed in the gate: a move that allows mate in one must read null, the real fork Nc7 still reads its sentence, and unmated moves still carry readings (so the guard is not a blanket null). NOT COVERED: the sentences other functions build on top of concreteRead (gates 132/133 pin those), the browser box.

breaks.name: guard-removed
breaks.why: the mate-in-one guard at the top of concreteRead is deleted, so Nc6 (Rb1 mates) reads a fork again (the job's defect)

breaks.name: guard-skips-captures
breaks.why: the guard is kept for quiet moves only, so a capture that allows mate still reads 'take it' / 'wins the X'

breaks.name: guard-nulls-every-move
breaks.why: the guard fires on every move (over-correction): no mated move reads anything, and neither does the real fork Nc7
